_comment: BTC true solo. Payout address is the one already recorded in this repo's
README, preserved verbatim. Verified: valid base58check, version 0x05 (P2SH).
Nothing here points at a pool: the bridge talks to your own bitcoind only.
_rpc_comment: cookie is the preferred auth: bitcoind writes ~/.bitcoin/.cookie with
random credentials on every start, so there is no password to store or
rotate. The installer creates it automatically once bitcoind has run.
_rpcuser_comment: Only used if you deliberately disable cookie auth.
_stratum_comment: Bound to 127.0.0.1 only. Solo mining pays the full block reward, so the
stratum port must never be exposed to a network you do not control:
anyone who can reach it can mine to your wallet, and anyone who reaches
the bridge with a stolen config can redirect the payout.
_listen_comment: The bridge refuses to bind anywhere but loopback by default.
_share_comment: Share difficulty 0.001 means one share per ~1000 network hashes. Stratum
uses this to meter hashrate; it does not change what counts as a block.
